cues.name: a1_steppe_wind
cues.cue: a. Cold open: steppe wind from frame 0
cues.source: procedural (noise through a wandering band-pass, gusts, faint whistle)
cues.processing: HP 90 Hz; in from frame 0 (40 ms de-click), out under the strings at 7.2 s (gone by 9.0 s)
cues.rationale: air before the picture; the cello alone reads as a void, the wind gives it a place

cues.name: a2_b_battle_bed
cues.cue: a/b. Distant battle bed: in at 1.7 s, low under the intro and verse 1, swell on 'slew each other on the shore', drains from 'when light went strange' to silence by 'warriors awed'
cues.source: ElevenLabs music-v2 (sfx:battle_bed, sfx:horses_far, sfx:river, sfx:blade_drop + test sfx_bronze_swords)
cues.processing: crowd/rumble LP 1.3 kHz, cavalry LP 1.6 kHz, river BP 250-2600 Hz, stitched without loop points; 34 far bronze clashes (pitched -3..+1 st, LP 1.4-2.8 kHz, 75% wet open-air tail, random pan, only in vocal gaps); presence dip -5 dB @ 2.6 kHz; ducked 4 dB under the lead vocal; drain = low-pass glide 7 kHz -> 220 Hz + gain to silence (87.68 -> 92.39 s)
cues.rationale: the war is going on out of frame; when the light goes strange the world loses its top end and goes quiet

cues.name: c1_evening_birds
cues.cue: c. Verse 2: faint evening birdsong from the first bar of verse 2, cut dead on 'quiet' (Birds went quiet)
cues.processing: liveliest 7.8 s of the take; BP 2.6-9.5 kHz; short air (RT 1.1 s, -12 dB); fade in 0.9 s; ducked 9 dB under the vocal; hard cut at 168.325 s (2 ms ramp, no reverb tail)
cues.rationale: the strangest real report from eclipses: birds stop singing. The cut is the event

cues.name: c2_cold_gust_air
cues.cue: c. Cold wind gust: 'air suddenly cold'
cues.source: procedural wind (higher, faster band than the steppe wind, faint whistle)
cues.processing: HP 300 Hz, dips -9 dB @ 2.3 kHz and -6 dB @ 4.2 kHz, ducked 7 dB under the vocal, L->R sweep, swell to peak at 169.94 s, out by 172.09 s
cues.rationale: temperature drops in totality; the second gust is the shadow arriving

cues.name: d_spark_shimmer
cues.cue: d. 'a sudden spark': crystalline shimmer / light-burst on 'spark' (the diamond ring)
cues.source: procedural (bell partials B7-F#8-B8-D9 + glass, 90 high glitter grains, open tail; reversed-tail pre-swell)

cues.name: e_armies_roar

cues.processing: loudest 4 s of the take; HP 180 Hz, LP 1.6 kHz, 70% wet open-air tail (RT 2.8 s), presence dip -6 dB; swell 0 -> +1.3 s, gone by +4.0 s; ducked 6 dB under the vocal
cues.rationale: the Reykjavik-crowd beat from the brief, kept far away so the choir stays in front

cues.name: f_blade_clang
